epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease local setup error rate from >50% to <5%
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml and a health-check endpoint, so that the stack can be launched locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean checkout of the repository, When docker-compose up is executed, Then the backend and frontend start successfully and the health-check endpoint returns HTTP 200.
Given a running stack, When unit and E2E tests are executed, Then all tests pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase catalog update completion rate from 0% to >99%
requirements: R1: Add UI functionality to update an existing material
R2: Add UI functionality to delete an existing material

slices.title: Implement material update and delete in UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to patch the existing UI to support update and delete actions, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user edits and saves it in the UI, Then a PUT request is made and the updated data is displayed.
Given an existing material, When a user deletes it in the UI, Then a DELETE request is made and the material is removed from the catalog.
Given the updated UI, When E2E and integration tests run, Then update and delete flows pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce material update cycle from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease unauthorized access attempts from unknown to 0%
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication and session mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication mechanism for this epic, I want to introduce a session verification layer, so that restricted data is protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted endpoints, Then they receive a 401 response and are prompted to log in.
Given valid credentials, When a user authenticates, Then a secure session is established.
Given the authentication implementation, When integration and E2E security tests run, Then unauthenticated access is strictly blocked.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access risk from 100% to 0%
